Add Mode:
 - Click and drag to add a line.
 - Starting at an existing line end automatically attaches them.

Edit Mode:
 - Nodes at end of line can be dragged. 
 - Click a line to select.
 - Selected lines can be dragged.
 - [Delete] to delete selected line

[Shift] or [Ctrl] or Right-Click to switch modes

The URL contains the current drawing. It can be saved or shared.
